crossRefs.note: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
As when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil; Make your name known to your adversaries…
I saw the earth, and, behold, it was waste and void, and the heavens, and they had no light.
Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea…
Won’t the land tremble for this, and everyone mourn who dwells in it? Yes, it will rise up wholly like the River; and…
The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all…
Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire…
Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.
He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The…
The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.
I saw a great white throne, and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. There was found…
Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.
Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
All of Mount Sinai smoked, because Yahweh descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace…
Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence.
As when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil; Make your name known to your adversaries…
A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”

translations.web: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
translations.bsb: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.
translations.kjv: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
translations.asv: Who looketh on the earth, and it trembleth; He toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.
